mutations.label: ⋯ does not cost a slot, so the row renders one control too many for the floor
the priority order is reversed: 🗑 delete returns to the inline row and the stateful 📌/🙈 are buried
the sheet's rows are inert — correct markup, no dispatch (markup-only assertions cannot see this)
the sheet does not close before running the action, so the result is hidden behind it
the budget is computed from a card width the CSS does not use (arithmetic about a layout that does not exist)
the selection checkbox goes back to 34x34, ten pixels under the family's touch floor
the checkbox's min-* floor is dropped, leaving only width/height a later rule could shrink
